description:
## [1.43.3](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/compare/v1.43.2...v1.43.3) (2026-10-12)

### 🦊 Firefox
- Update New Tab Mod Settings Logic

### 🚫 Remove Ads
- Remove Ads patch updated
- Updated `AdIdMatching.kt`

### 🧹 Junk Clean
- Added more junk entries for Junk Clean

### 📅 Calendar 2026 Patches
- Added support for Calendar 2026 v2.1.
- Added Boost Splash patch to remove startup delays.
- Added Skip Consent Form patch to bypass consent form requests on launch.
- Added Skip Initial Setup Pages patch to bypass phone, overlay, and notification permission setup.
- Added Disable Caller Related Features patch to disable caller ID features, phone state receiver, and related Settings entry.
- Added Stop Hiding Navigation Keys patch to keep system navigation bar visible.

### 📅 Calendar Patches
- Added support for Calendar v1.0.35.
- Added Unlock Premium patch to unlock premium features and hide premium entry in Settings.
- Added Boost Splash Screen patch to skip splash ads and consent requests for faster startup.
- Added Skip Initial Setup Pages patch to bypass permission and after-call setup screens.
- Added Disable Caller Features patch to disable the after-call screen and hide its Settings entry.
- Added Disable Rate Us Prompts patch to disable feedback screens and recurring rating prompts.
- Added Remove Battery Optimization Prompt patch to remove the dashboard battery optimization request.
- Added Stop Hiding Navigation Keys patch to keep system navigation buttons visible.

### ▶️ Mx Player
- Updated Mx Player Mod Settings Ui
